method: Parse one written pitch as a letter, an optional sharp, flat or natural accidental, and an octave from -1 through 9. The selected one of 15 major-key signatures supplies an accidental when the written note has no explicit accidental and supplies the accidentals for diatonic upper and lower letter-name neighbours. Moving above B increments the octave; moving below C decrements it. Turns produce upper-main-lower-main, inverted turns produce lower-main-upper-main, upper mordents produce main-upper-main and lower mordents produce main-lower-main. Trills from the written note repeat main-upper for the selected 1 to 8 alternations and finish on the main note; trills from above repeat upper-main and finish on the main note. The output specifies pitch order only, not rhythm or historical performance conventions.
